name: Disneyland Docking Bay 7 Batuuan Beef Pot Roast & Cavatappi Pasta / Mash (Hold Pickled Onions & Jalapeños!)
brandOrRestaurant: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Slow-braised beef pot roast is fork-tender; asking the kitchen to leave off the pickled red onions, cilantro, and sliced jalapeños makes the braised beef and pasta/mash base very gentle.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Braised Beef dish and ask at the counter for **NO jalapeños** and **NO pickled onions** on top (or push them completely off before eating).
watchOuts: Always remove the sliced jalapeño garnish and pickled red onions on top
